theme.description: Strictly Apple Monochrome with solid black buttons, white crisp cards, subtle gray surfaces, and clean 1px borders. Zero colorful accent gradients.

components: Sync status pill: 'Tersimpan di HP (Draft Lokal)' (bg-[#F2F2F7] text-[#1D1D1F] border border-[#D2D2D7]) OR 'Tersinkronisasi Server' (bg-black text-white)
Single-day Date Picker trigger button with formatted date

sticky_bottom_nav.style: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-lg bg-white/85 border-t border-[#D2D2D7] px-2 py-2 shadow-lg

layout_and_cards.mobile_first_rule: Vertical stacked cards per stand. NO horizontal scrolling container on mobile screen.
layout_and_cards.container_padding: px-4 pt-4 pb-24 max-w-2xl mx-auto space-y-4
layout_and_cards.card_style: bg-white rounded-2xl border border-[#D2D2D7]/80 p-4 sm:p-5 shadow-sm space-y-3 relative transition-all duration-200 hover:border-black/40

stand_card_structure.header: Stand Name, Type Badge (AMK / AMKopi), Fill Status Indicator
stand_card_structure.omset_input: Full-width numeric field for Omset Rp with automatic Rp currency formatting and tabular-nums
stand_card_structure.cups_grid: 3-column grid (12oz, 22oz, 16oz) numeric input fields with crisp borders and integer validation
stand_card_structure.spg_grid: 3-column grid (SPG 1, SPG 2, SPG 3) text input fields with datalist auto-complete suggestions

tab_1_input_harian.title: Input Harian Sales & Cup
tab_1_input_harian.description: List of stands with Omset Rp, Cup sizes, and SPG inputs
features: Filter stand cards by quick chips (Semua, AMK, AMKopi, Belum Diisi)
Instant local draft auto-save to localStorage on every change
Visual completion checkmark on card header when Omset > 0
Reset and Sync buttons in floating bar or bottom actions

tab_2_wa_generator.title: WA Report Generator
tab_2_wa_generator.description: Formats daily entries into structured WhatsApp text report for direct copying
features: Monospaced Live Preview card with dark mode Apple terminal aesthetic
Copy to Clipboard button ('Salin Ke WhatsApp') with visual toast notification

tab_3_pivot_and_export.title: Pivot & Excel Export
tab_3_pivot_and_export.description: Multi-matrix analytics with customizable date range picker
matrices: Matrix 1: Total Omset (Rp) per Stand vs Date
Matrix 2: Percup Sales Matrix (12oz, 22oz, 16oz) per Stand
Matrix 3: SPG Shift Schedule Matrix per Stand
tab_3_pivot_and_export.excel_export: Single button trigger generating Excel XLSX file with 3 distinct sheets (Sheet 1: Omset, Sheet 2: Percup, Sheet 3: SPG Detail)

tab_4_settings.title: Master Data & Preferences
tab_4_settings.description: Manage stands, item master data, and dummy data triggers
features: CRUD Stand List (Nama Stand, Kode, Tipe: AMK/AMKopi)
CRUD Item Master List (Key & Cup sizes)
Button: Generate Data Dummy (Populates 7 days of realistic sales data)
Button: Hapus Semua Data (Clears local draft database with confirmation dialog)

testing_and_data_attributes.rule: Every interactive input, filter, tab button, table, and modal MUST contain kebab-case data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Apple Monochrome design language: pure black (#000000), off-black (#1D1D1F), pure white (#FFFFFF), Apple gray background (#F5F5F7), border gray (#D2D2D7). No colorful status bars or rainbow badges.
Ensure numbers use tabular-nums font styling for clean alignment in input cards and pivot tables.
Keep mobile layout strictly vertical with card stacks; no horizontal overflow on mobile viewports.
Use Bahasa Indonesia for all UI labels, field titles, sync statuses, toast notifications, and WA output text.
Ensure all interactive components have appropriate data-testid attributes.
Use Sonner for toast notifications when copying WA reports, saving drafts, or clearing data.
